given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner has submitted a Delivery Proof indicating a delivery exception
given_when_then.when: The system processes the delivery proof
given_when_then.then: A Dispute Ticket is automatically generated with status 'Open' and linked to the Order Request

given_when_then.given: The system has created a Dispute Ticket with status 'Open'
given_when_then.when: The system executes the notification routine
given_when_then.then: The Customer and the Delivery Partner are notified of the dispute creation and required actions

given_when_then.given: The Customer has logged into the platform
given_when_then.when: The Customer views the Dispute Ticket details
given_when_then.then: The Customer sees the dispute creation notification and the required actions to resolve the dispute

given_when_then.given: The Delivery Partner has received the notification
given_when_then.when: The Delivery Partner views the Dispute Ticket
given_when_then.then: The Delivery Partner sees the dispute creation notification and the required actions

given_when_then.given: A Customer reports a missing item and the system attempts to generate a Dispute Ticket
given_when_then.when: The system detects the delivery proof is missing or incomplete
given_when_then.then: The system creates a Dispute Ticket with status 'Pending Investigation' and notifies the Customer

success_criteria: The Customer receives a notification regarding the creation of a new Dispute Ticket and required actions immediately after the ticket is generated.
The Delivery Partner receives a notification regarding the creation of a new Dispute Ticket and required actions immediately after the ticket is generated.
The Dispute Ticket is automatically generated with status 'Open' and linked to the Order Request when a Delivery Proof indicates an exception.
The Dispute Ticket is generated with status 'Pending Investigation' when a Customer reports a missing item and the delivery proof is missing or incomplete.
The notification content clearly specifies the required actions for both the Customer and the Delivery Partner.
